title: Comparison of two approaches for discharging LiFePO4 EV battery packs and comprehensive analysis of recovered cathodes for direct recycling purposes
content:
Energy Adv., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6YA00039H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Simon Duda, Deise F. Barbosa de Mattos, Laura Altenschmidt, Fredrik Lindgren, Lars-Erik Ohlsson, Martina Petranikova
Resistor discharge yields a higher lithiated cathode material with less Cu and Al impurities. Brine discharge leads to corrosion, wastewater generation and increased impurities; hence, it was deemed less advantageous for direct recycling purposes.
